text:
Sofia: Quick check-in before cut: we need to lock scope for the cutover tomorrow. Must-have: SLA table, support playbook, docs quickstart, monitoring dashboard, pricing draft. Who picks what?

Marco: I'll take monitoring + canary smoke checklist. Proposed metrics: per-route p95, total token/sec, 5xx ratio, cache hit ratio, and a deploy-time synthetic that validates streaming output. I'll sketch a Grafana panel and shared folder.

Anya: Docs owner here. Deliverables: quickstart (JS + Python), a short errors section showing typical error codes and retry patterns, and a migration note for customers moving from legacy endpoints. I want sample snippets for streaming reconnect logic.

Devin: SLA & runbooks. Draft SLA tiers: Standard (99.5% uptime, 24h business support), Business (99.8%, 4h P1 response), Enterprise (99.95% + dedicated onboarding). Need legal + commercial approval for wording. Runbook: incident classification + contact matrix + fallback to smaller model variant.

Priya: Pricing note: GA should ship with a simple per-token price + embedding unit price. Add a pilot-discount coupon for early enterprise customers. FinOps will need the expected token distribution to sanity-check revenue impact.

Marco: Alerts I'd wire: alert if rate(5xx) > 0.5% for 10m, or p95_latency > 350ms for 5m, or cache_hit < 60% for 15m. Also alert on token-cost delta > 25% vs baseline.

Sofia: Important scope decision: drop experimental custom-quantization and advanced autoscaling policies from GA. We'll mark both "alpha" and document migration paths. Agree?

Anya: Agree. Docs will include a short "coming soon" card and a guide for customers using quantized artifacts.

Devin: Action items: I'll draft SLA wording and the 2-week warm-oncall rota. Recommend one escalation responder each weekday for first 14 days.

Priya: I'll assemble a pricing stub and include the pilot discount terms. Will ask FinOps to review by Friday.

Sofia: Can we add a 4-item PR checklist before merging: 1) SLA anchor link, 2) runbook PR link, 3) support contact doc, 4) monitoring dashboard link. If all green we cut.

Marco: I'll push the dashboard JSON and link it. Also will add a small playbook snippet showing the steps to rollback model route if latency spikes.

Anya: Starting the docs PR now. Will attach code samples and an errors table.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: tomorrow 02:30 UTC. Reminder: run synthetic streaming smoke and validate token accounting.

Sofia: Thanks everyone. I'll send an owners email with the recap and deadlines. Let's aim to have PR checklist items validated 12h before the canary.
